Technical details

  


  
PICK YOUR STARTING POINT
The garage.
Your vehicles, your colors. Rotate a model, choose its paint, then head back to the trail.
The garage uses the same vehicle models as the driving view. Paint is saved for each vehicle. Drag to rotate, or focus a model and use the arrow keys. 


  
BUILD FOR THE TERRAIN
The workshop.
Choose parts, inspect the changes, then take your build to the trail.


  
KNOW YOUR MACHINE
Field guide.


  
MAKE YOURSELF COMFORTABLE
Display & session.
Keyboard, touch, and standard gamepads are supported. Graphics quality changes rendering; the vehicle model always runs at a fixed 120 Hz.
START FRESH
Clears tire tracks and restores the ground. Vehicle damage and setup are preserved.
VEHICLE & SCENERY
Repairs the current vehicle, clears tire tracks and restores damaged scenery. Your paint colors and display settings stay saved.
